worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.summary: Step in and cross both claws in front of you, tearing everyone in the corridor: a tear has the family's best chance to lower a target's Defence by a stage, and a target already carrying the guardbroken identity loses one more. Heavier than Rock Smash, quicker than Iron Tail.
The cross slash deals %1$s contact damage.
You step in %1$s blocks with a %2$s block corridor half-width.
A landed tear has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Defence by %2$s stage; a target already carrying the guardbroken identity loses %3$s more stage, and the rent mark lasts %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.growth.0: From level %1$s the slash rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.growth.1: From level %1$s the tear chance rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.use.0: Tear a guard open with a cross slash
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.use.1: Rip a crack someone else already opened
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.use.2: Trade one mid-range blow for a Defence drop
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of tearing. Larger values open with the slash from further out.
On: prefer targets already carrying the guardbroken identity from any source, deepening the drop by a stage. Off: treat it as an ordinary mid-range slash.
